title: Engineering Manager
description: Comprehensive path for engineering leadership: IC-to-EM transition, high-impact 1:1s, coaching, hiring, DORA velocity metrics, blameless postmortems, org design, and strategic leadership.

phases.title: People & 1:1 Foundations
phases.focus: IC-to-EM Transition, High-Impact 1:1s, Feedback Models & Career Ladders

phases.title: Execution & Operational Health
phases.focus: Performance Management, Hiring Pipelines, Team Trust, DORA Velocity & Tech Debt

phases.title: Cross-Functional & Org Scaling
phases.focus: Stakeholder Partnering, Blameless Incidents, Staff+ Coaching & Team Topologies

phases.title: Executive & Strategic Mastery
phases.focus: Engineering Strategy, Business Alignment, and Executive Board Reporting

nodes.title: The Transition from IC to Engineering Manager
nodes.subtitle: The shift from coding to coaching, letting go of code ownership, the EM calendar
learning_objectives: Overcome the productivity guilt of writing less code while managing engineers
Define the core responsibilities of an EM: people, execution, and strategy
feynman_prompts: Why is continuing to take critical-path coding tasks harmful as an Engineering Manager?
key_misconceptions: Measuring your personal daily productivity by GitHub commits rather than team enablement

nodes.title: High-Impact 1:1s & Active Listening
nodes.subtitle: 1:1 meeting architecture, active listening, asking powerful open questions, psychological safety
learning_objectives: Conduct recurring 1:1 meetings focused on engineer growth rather than status updates
Demonstrate active listening and create an atmosphere of psychological safety
feynman_prompts: Why should a 1:1 meeting belong to the engineer rather than the manager?
key_misconceptions: Turning weekly 1:1s into project status reports that could have been handled asynchronously

nodes.title: Constructive Feedback & Coaching Frameworks
nodes.subtitle: SBI model (Situation-Behavior-Impact), radical candor, coaching vs directing
learning_objectives: Deliver timely, actionable constructive feedback using the SBI framework
Practice the Radical Candor matrix (Care Personally + Challenge Directly)
feynman_prompts: Why is withholding critical feedback out of kindness actually ruinous empathy?
key_misconceptions: Saving up negative feedback for annual reviews instead of delivering it in real-time

nodes.title: Career Ladders, Growth Plans & Mentorship
nodes.subtitle: Competency matrices, engineering levels (Junior to Staff), IDPs, mentorship pairing
learning_objectives: Map individual contributors to company engineering ladders with clear expectations
Co-create Individual Development Plans (IDP) tailored to personal career goals
feynman_prompts: How do you explain the qualitative leap between Senior Engineer and Staff Engineer?
key_misconceptions: Promoting engineers based solely on tenure rather than sustained competency demonstration

nodes.title: Performance Management & Navigating PIPs
nodes.subtitle: Managing underperformance, documented remediation, fair PIP processes, terminations
learning_objectives: Identify root causes of underperformance (skill gap vs motivation vs personal distress)
Write unambiguous, measurable Performance Improvement Plans (PIP)
feynman_prompts: Why should a PIP outcome never come as a complete surprise to an underperforming engineer?
key_misconceptions: Avoiding difficult conversations with underperformers hoping the problem solves itself

nodes.title: Technical Hiring & Inclusive Interview Pipelines
nodes.subtitle: Structured interviewing, rubrics, anti-bias training, candidate experience, closing offers
learning_objectives: Design structured interview loops with standardized evaluation rubrics
Conduct debrief calibration meetings that mitigate unconscious hiring biases
feynman_prompts: Why are standardized interview questions superior to freeform conversational interviews?
key_misconceptions: Relying on vague 'culture fit' gut feelings during hiring debriefs

nodes.title: Building High-Trust Culture & Psychological Safety
nodes.subtitle: Team charters, blameless culture, managing conflict, burnout prevention, recognition
learning_objectives: Facilitate team retrospectives that identify systemic friction without personal blame
Recognize early warning signs of developer burnout and proactively rebalance workload
feynman_prompts: What is Google's Project Aristotle and why did psychological safety emerge as #1?
key_misconceptions: Punishing honest mistakes, which drives engineers to hide outages and tech debt

nodes.title: Engineering Metrics & DORA Principles
nodes.subtitle: DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, Change Fail Rate, MTTR), SPACE framework
learning_objectives: Track and improve the 4 key DORA metrics across team deployment pipelines
Utilize the SPACE framework to balance velocity, satisfaction, and flow state
feynman_prompts: Why is measuring individual lines of code or PR counts a dangerous anti-pattern?
key_misconceptions: Gamifying engineering metrics such that engineers write smaller useless PRs to boost stats

nodes.title: Sprint Planning, Estimation & Capacity Management
nodes.subtitle: Story point estimation, team velocity, buffer allocation, roadmap predictability
learning_objectives: Forecast team delivery timelines using rolling historical velocity and capacity buffers
Prevent scope blowouts by enforcing clear definition of done and WIP limits
feynman_prompts: Why should teams never plan for 100% engineering capacity in a sprint?
key_misconceptions: Treating story point estimates as firm contractual guarantees

nodes.title: Managing Technical Debt & Refactoring Strategy
nodes.subtitle: Debt quadrants, negotiating debt payoffs with PMs, architectural debt, maintenance ratios
learning_objectives: Quantify the business cost of technical debt to gain PM and leadership buy-in
Allocate a consistent 15-20% capacity budget for system refactoring and hygiene
feynman_prompts: How do you explain the compounding interest of technical debt to a non-technical PM?
key_misconceptions: Allowing the entire codebase to degrade until a catastrophic, multi-month rewrite is demanded

nodes.title: Cross-Functional Partnering & Managing Up
nodes.subtitle: Partnering with PM, Design, and Sales, communicating risks to executives, stakeholder updates
learning_objectives: Communicate technical delays early with clear impact analysis and remediation options
Build tight collaborative triad relationships with Product Managers and Design Leads
feynman_prompts: Why is announcing a project delay 2 days before launch an executive communication failure?
key_misconceptions: Filtering all bad news upward to look good until an unpreventable crisis explodes

nodes.title: Incident Response & Blameless Postmortems
nodes.subtitle: On-call rotation design, SEV classification, incident commander role, 5 Whys, action items
learning_objectives: Establish sustainable on-call rotations that protect engineers from alert fatigue
Run blameless postmortem meetings focusing on systemic root causes rather than human error
feynman_prompts: Why does naming an individual in an incident report destroy engineering trust?
key_misconceptions: Treating an incident postmortem as a punitive trial rather than an organizational learning tool

nodes.title: Coaching Staff+ Engineers & Technical Leadership
nodes.subtitle: Sponsoring Staff/Principal engineers, technical roadmaps, navigating tech vs people track
learning_objectives: Partner with Staff+ engineers on multi-year technical vision and architectural RFCs
Sponsor senior talent into high-visibility company-wide technical initiatives
feynman_prompts: How does managing a Staff Engineer differ fundamentally from managing a Senior Engineer?
key_misconceptions: Micro-managing Staff engineers on task-level details instead of guiding organizational impact

nodes.title: Organization Design & Team Topologies
nodes.subtitle: Stream-aligned vs enabling vs platform vs subsystem teams, Conway's Law, sizing teams
learning_objectives: Apply Team Topologies patterns to optimize team boundaries and reduce cognitive load
Restructure engineering groups according to Conway's Law and software boundaries
feynman_prompts: Explain Conway's Law and its implications for team structure.
key_misconceptions: Creating teams around technical layers (e.g. 'DB team', 'CSS team') rather than value streams

nodes.title: Engineering Headcount, Budgets & Vendor Selection
nodes.subtitle: Headcount planning, cloud spend optimization (FinOps), build vs buy evaluations
learning_objectives: Develop annual headcount hiring models tied to product growth targets
Evaluate enterprise vendor licensing and cloud compute costs (build vs buy)
feynman_prompts: How do you evaluate whether to build a custom internal tool versus paying for SaaS?
key_misconceptions: Underestimating the long-term maintenance and engineering salary costs of building in-house

nodes.title: Remote & Globally Distributed Engineering Management
nodes.subtitle: Async communication hygiene, documentation culture, timezone overlap, inclusion
learning_objectives: Establish asynchronous engineering workflows that empower distributed team members
Maintain team cohesion and social trust across disparate international timezones
feynman_prompts: Why does default-to-meeting culture severely disadvantage remote engineers?
key_misconceptions: Expecting remote workers to conform to a single headquarters timezone's working hours

nodes.title: Engineering Strategy & Business Alignment
nodes.subtitle: Translating business OKRs into engineering strategy, tech horizon scanning, M&A due diligence
learning_objectives: Synthesize company business OKRs into coherent multi-quarter engineering strategies
Guide enterprise tech modernization while maintaining zero downtime business continuity
feynman_prompts: How do you align technical modernization with long-term commercial goals?
key_misconceptions: Viewing engineering as an isolated cost center rather than a primary business driver

nodes.title: Executive Presence, Board Reporting & Leadership
nodes.subtitle: C-suite communication, engineering department health reports, crisis leadership
learning_objectives: Present engineering ROI and reliability metrics to the CEO and Board of Directors
Lead the engineering organization through layoffs, reorganizations, and crises with empathy
feynman_prompts: How do you present complex system outages to non-technical board members?
key_misconceptions: Drowning executives in low-level technical jargon instead of business impact and risk mitigations
